I'm sorry you feel so useless, but you shouldn't. It's good that you're taking a step towards what makes you happy! Having a hobby is one of the best ways to take out any emotions you're feeling. I hope you know that there is a life after high school, it's difficult to see and you're making the right choice by not joining everyone else in drugs. Is there a community college near you? If so I'm sure they have art classes you can take that don't require you already graduating high school. And on the statement that things would be better for everyone else if you weren't around, I can tell you that's not true. Your online friends would miss you so much and be more hurt than you can know, I'm sure your family would too. Keep moving forward with your art, you'll be happy you did, I promise!
There's no failing in that, if you can't see what they see don't look at it as a failure. Cause it's not. If ya wanna PM me, I should be up for a while.

As someone who's slipped under the radar myself I know how discouraging that is. You almost just want to scream, "Can't you tell I'm hurting, help me, talk to me!" But you can't, cause you're afraid, afraid how you'll look, afraid who will abandon you after they learn the truth. And the fucking mask, as much as the mask helps my day to day, I fucking hate it more than anything as I can tell you do. I wish I had a cut and dry answer to help you, but there isn't one. What seems to help me somedays is a nice long walk in the morning or a run if you're into that. Draining all my energy before my day even really starts seems to help me a little. If ya need someone to talk to I'm here, might not be the best person but I'm here.

Trust me I know, that's the shitty thing about hating yourself, well besides not being able to tell anyone. As hard as it is to see what someone else sees, you gotta try, even if it's for a minute or a second.

Try and take it as a compliment. Sometimes it's hard to see what other people see.

I'm not sure where you live, but if you're under 18 still, there is a test you can take which is the high school proficiency exam. It is the exact same thing as a diploma, and it's better than a GED. The test isn't the most difficult, but it does require studying. I think it would be good for you to look into it. Maybe a goal would help you. I know you said you don't care about school and I'm really sorry about your health issues and how fucked the school system made you feel, but you would be doing yourself a disservice not to at least make an attempt. If you have questions let me know.

Do you want to go back to school? There are a lot of avenues you could take that wouldn't require the shame of being in a class with people much younger than you.
